notes: False: row 120 of 3-row Chomp is in neither A029902 (h) nor A029905 (r). For q >= 170 the P-positions of row 120 are (q+72,q,120), (q+70,q,120) alternating with the parity of q, forever; no (q,q,120) is a P-position. Proof: recurrence for f(q,r) re-derived from the move rules (brute-force checked for p <= 14), then a finite-state certificate per row (state = used offsets S_q, lower rows certified eventually periodic) proves rows 0..125 eventually periodic; rows other than 120 fall in exactly one set, matching OEIS data. Outside Lean: everything (Python certificate chomp_rows.py; recurrence derivation by hand).
